description: The GNOME desktop on Wayland, logged in as the box user at start: the image and its boxes get a screen, shown with box view (Debian and Ubuntu images; GNOME needs polkitd, and the polkit parameter says how it answers)

polkit.description: how polkitd, which GNOME needs, answers a program that asks for a privileged action: deny refuses every request; debian follows the system's own rules (Debian's, or Ubuntu's in an Ubuntu image), so the box user and every program it runs, an agent included, can power the box off and mount disks and disk images without a password. Recipes/README.md says more

steps.name: A polkit choice this recipe knows
steps.run: case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT" in deny|debian) echo "polkit=$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT";; *) echo "the polkit parameter is deny or debian, not '$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT'" >&2; exit 1;; esac

steps.name: GNOME, its terminal and file manager, the GDM login manager and the accessibility bus, without recommended packages
steps.run: apt-get -q -y update && apt-get -q -y --no-install-recommends install gnome-session gdm3 gnome-terminal nautilus xdg-user-dirs at-spi2-core

steps.name: polkitd's rules, as the polkit parameter says
steps.run: rules=/etc/polkit-1/rules.d/00-agent-vm.rules; case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT" in deny) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=deny' 'polkit.addRule(function (action, subject) { return action.id == "org.freedesktop.login1.chvt" ? polkit.Result.YES : polkit.Result.NO; });' > "$rules.new";; debian) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=debian' > "$rules.new";; *) echo "the polkit parameter is deny or debian, not '$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT'" >&2; exit 1;; esac && chmod 644 "$rules.new" && mv -f "$rules.new" "$rules"

steps.name: The box user logged in to GNOME at start, with no password (in the file each system's GDM reads: daemon.conf on Debian, custom.conf on Ubuntu)
steps.run: conf=/etc/gdm3/daemon.conf; if grep -qx 'ID=ubuntu' /etc/os-release; then conf=/etc/gdm3/custom.conf; fi; printf '%s\n' '[daemon]' 'AutomaticLoginEnable=true' "AutomaticLogin=$AGENT_VM_BOX_USER" '' '[security]' '' '[xdmcp]' '' '[chooser]' '' '[debug]' > "$conf"

steps.name: The screen never locks, blanks or sleeps
The desktop starts with the system

update.name: polkitd's rules, as the polkit parameter now says
update.run: rules=/etc/polkit-1/rules.d/00-agent-vm.rules; case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT" in deny) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=deny' 'polkit.addRule(function (action, subject) { return action.id == "org.freedesktop.login1.chvt" ? polkit.Result.YES : polkit.Result.NO; });' > "$rules.new";; debian) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=debian' > "$rules.new";; *) echo "the polkit parameter is deny or debian, not '$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT'" >&2; exit 1;; esac && chmod 644 "$rules.new" && mv -f "$rules.new" "$rules"

checks: [ "$(systemctl show -P Id display-manager.service)" = gdm.service ] && echo 'GDM starts with the system'
[ "$(systemctl get-default)" = graphical.target ] && echo 'the system starts to graphical.target'
conf=/etc/gdm3/daemon.conf; if grep -qx 'ID=ubuntu' /etc/os-release; then conf=/etc/gdm3/custom.conf; fi; grep -qx "AutomaticLogin=$(id -un)" "$conf" && echo "$(id -un) is logged in at start"

[ "$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.screensaver lock-enabled) $(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.lockdown disable-lock-screen) $(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay)" = 'false true uint32 0' ] && echo 'the screen never locks or blanks'

pkcheck --action-id org.freedesktop.login1.power-off --process $$ > /dev/null 2>&1; answer=$?; case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT:$answer" in deny:1) echo 'polkitd refuses every request (polkit=deny)';; debian:2) echo "polkitd follows the system's own rules (polkit=debian): what they allow the desktop's user, every program of $(id -un) can do";; *) echo "polkit=$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT, and polkitd answered $answer to a request to power off"; exit 1;; esac
